narrative.narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, was a 65.6 million dollar net inflow, 0.024 percent of custodied value, versus a 366.5 million dollar inflow on the prior print, which means dollars are still arriving but at a fraction of that intake. Binance took in 30.3 million dollars, down from 321.7 million dollars, which means the largest venue where holders can sell no longer draws the bulk of arrivals. Bybit intake fell to 102.8 million dollars from 168.3 million dollars, while Bitfinex intake rose to 23.8 million dollars from 4.9 million dollars, which means leftover arrivals are smaller at Bybit and only modestly larger at Bitfinex.
